description.narrative: By supporting women – and promoting dialogue among and between them – the programme will seek to ensure that women change agents from all ages and backgrounds work towards a more just, peaceful, and inclusive society.
Formal and informal networks of activists; women's groups; civil society leaders; traditional religious and community leaders; local officials; international and regional actors.

Specific objectives: 1) The women’s movement is more inclusive for creating social change; 2) Traditional gender norms are challenged by new gender values, behaviors, and practices; 3) Women’s participation is more diverse and legitimate in peacebuilding.
This regional programme is part of a broader international programme implemented by a coalition of NGOs lead by PAX.

title.narrative: 1. Women’s movement is more inclusive for creating social change
# of individuals (female) with strengthened capacity (knowledge and skills) to advance women’s rights and gender equality

comment.narrative: As seen in the baseline assessment, young women activists have little to no capacities when it comes to strategic planning, leadership and digital security. This is largely due to many of the activists engaging in activism for the first time in 2019 in the October revolution. They do have knowledge on physical security due to their own experiences, but not formalised, structured knowledge.
Description of how, as a result of capacity strengthening targeted individuals have improved

155 young women activists were trained in 6 governorates on protecting themselves from online threats such as impersonation, spyware, and electronic blackmail. They also learned how to identify safe and secure online platforms. These trainings had a positive impact on government agencies, particularly women's empowerment departments, and other activists. 13 between the age of 20 to 30 and the rest were from 30 to 40
Training completed in all governorates in June. The training focused on how to create more inclusivity and diversity in project strategy and activities.
